name: Calendar
description: Turn event details into a calendar (.ics) file for any calendar app.

inputs.label: View
inputs.help: The card is the shareable event summary. The month grid is the sheet you print and pin up - picking it sets the export size to A4 landscape.

inputs.label: Month
inputs.help: Which month to draw, as YYYY-MM. Leave blank to use the month of the earliest date you have entered. There is no clock here, so with no month and no dates the grid asks you for one rather than guessing.

inputs.label: Week numbers
inputs.help: Add an ISO-8601 week number column. ISO weeks are Monday based, so on a Sunday-start grid each row shows the week of the Monday inside it.

inputs.label: Event name
inputs.help: Shows as the calendar entry's title (SUMMARY).

inputs.label: Starts
inputs.help: Local start date and time. Leave blank to default to today. Shared with Meeting Planner so a batch sheet's date column drives both.

inputs.label: Ends
inputs.help: Optional. Leave blank for a 1-hour event.

inputs.label: All-day event
inputs.help: Ignore the time of day and book the whole date.

inputs.label: Location
inputs.placeholder: e.g. Nuremberg, or a meeting link
inputs.help: Where it happens - a place or a URL. Shared id with Meeting Planner (city).

inputs.label: Description
inputs.help: Notes that ride along in the calendar entry.

inputs.label: Event URL
inputs.help: Optional link attached to the event.

inputs.label: Reminder
inputs.help: Add a pop-up alarm before the event starts.

inputs.label: More dates
inputs.help: Extra entries. They fill the month grid, and each one with a date and a title also rides along in the .ics as its own calendar entry. A row missing either is counted under the grid, never dropped in silence.
